text: Each piece of this program was validated on its own as it was built. This final pass asks a question none of those earlier checks asked: do all four pieces agree with each other, right now, at the same time, across both OT segments?

Four things get checked together: segmentation on both segments, identity counts matching across Azure AD and AWS, the automation running on schedule with its sweep completed, and the risk register closed with every corrective action complete.

Checking these together, not separately, is what catches a seam — a gap that exists only between two individually correct components, invisible to either one checked alone, the same way the original discrepancy was only visible between two methods, not inside either one.

This is Lesson 24's discipline, one level up: don't trust each piece's own last report, confirm agreement across all of them, right now. Only then is the program actually done. Next lesson closes the capstone out.
